important_instructions: Terms of appointment: on absorption OR on deputation for 03 years, extendable further as per rules, subject to extension of exemption from the rule of immediate absorption beyond 01.11.2028 by Ministry/DPE. Serving Government, PSU, Port and JV candidates who are shortlisted must submit a "No Objection Certificate" from their employer at the time of Personal Interview. Travelling expenses will be paid to candidates for appearing in the Personal Interview as per Company Policy. Three-month advance notice is required before seeking resignation from IPRCL. Canvassing in any form will disqualify a candidate. IPRCL will not correspond about deficiencies in applications or with candidates not shortlisted or not selected. IPRCL has the right to increase or decrease the number of posts or cancel the circular entirely or partially without assigning any reason. Any corrigendum, interview intimation, results or panels will be posted only in the 'Career' section of the IPRCL website (www.iprcl.in). Disputes are subject to the sole jurisdiction of Courts at Mumbai. Contact printed on the notice: Ph. No. 022-6656 6340, Fax No. 022-6656 6336, Email [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About IPRCL
content_sections.text: Indian Port Rail & Ropeway Corporation Limited describes itself as a first of its kind Joint Venture Company between 11 Major Ports under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, holding 90% of the equity, and Rail Vikas Nigam Limited under the Ministry of Railways, holding 10%. It was incorporated to provide efficient rail evacuation systems to Major Ports and to enhance their capacity and throughput. The company was registered on 10th July 2015 as a Public Limited Company under the Companies Act, 2013; its Corporate Office is in Mazgaon, Mumbai and its Registered Office is at NBCC Place, Lodhi Road, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications go only on paper, by post / courier or dropped personally, to this address: Chief General Manager (HR), Indian Port Rail & Ropeway Corporation Ltd (IPRCL), 4th Floor, Nirman Bhavan, Mumbai Port Trust Building, M.P. Road, Mazgaon (E), Mumbai- 400010. Use Annexure-II (Application Form for applying on absorption only) or Annexure-III (Application Format for Deputation), both printed with the notice. Write "Application for the post of ______" on the top of the envelope, filling in the post applied for. Candidates currently serving in Railways, other Govt. departments, Central PSUs, Ports or JV Companies under Govt. Control must submit the application with enclosures through proper channel only, along with photocopies of their last 05 years APARs. No column of the application form should be left blank; otherwise the form may be rejected. The particulars given in the form are treated as final. A candidate eligible for both posts who wishes to apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. The last date for submission of the application is 4 December 2026. IPRCL will not be held responsible if a candidate cannot submit the application by the last date for whatever reason.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of these documents go with the application, and the originals must be produced if called for the Personal Interview: Matriculation Certificate (for age proof). Certificates and Mark-sheets in support of the required educational/professional qualifications. Certificates in proof of experience, clearly indicating the length and field of experience. Copy of the appointment letter for the post in the present organisation, with valid Identity card/Current Pay Slip issued by the company. Copies of last 5 years APARs/ACRs (not applicable to officers working in a Private Company). Latest updated detailed CV. Photo I.D. proof and address proof (Passport/Aadhaar Card/Driving License/PAN card/ Voter Card) issued by Central/State Govt. 'No Objection Certificate' if working in Railways, other Govt. departments, Central PSUs, Ports, JV Companies under Govt. Control (not applicable to candidates working in a Private Company). Copy of Audited balance sheet for proof of Sales Turnover (only for candidates working in a Private Company). A recent passport size photograph affixed on the Annexure-II form.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the IPRCL Sr. Manager (Electrical) and Manager (Electrical) posts involves shortlisting followed by a Personal Interview. Shortlisting: suitable candidates will be shortlisted based on their eligibility/experience in the relevant field and may be called for interview. When there are 05 or more eligible candidates for each vacancy, IPRCL reserves the right to shortlist in the ratio of 1:5. Personal Interview: may be held at the Corporate Office of IPRCL, through V.C. or at any other location at the discretion of IPRCL. Intimation will be given through e-mail/IPRCL website. Document verification at the interview: original documents of educational qualifications, experience, age etc. are verified at the Personal Interview. A candidate whose identity is in doubt, who cannot produce the documents, whose documents do not match, or who is found ineligible will not be allowed to appear in the Personal Interview, and the candidature will be treated as cancelled. Medical examination: applicants should be physically and medically fit; on selection, the candidate will have to undergo a medical examination as per the corporation's policy.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IPRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 02 posts of Sr. Manager (Electrical) - E3 / Manager (Electrical) - E2, with tentative posting of 01 at Mumbai and 01 at NMHC-Lothal.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IPRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the application is 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the IPRCL Sr. Manager and Manager (Electrical) posts?
faq.answer: A Full time Degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized University, with experience in Execution of Infrastructure Projects; the degree requirement does not apply to candidates applying on deputation.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IPRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: On absorption, up to 40 years for Sr. Manager (Electrical) and up to 35 years for Manager (Electrical); on deputation, up to 57 years, all as on 04.12.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of IPRCL Sr. Manager and Manager (Electrical)?
faq.answer: On absorption, the IDA scale is Rs. 60000-180000/- for Sr. Manager (Electrical) and Rs. 50000-160000/- for Manager (Electrical), plus applicable allowances and PRP; deputationists get parent pay and allowances plus Deputation Duty Allowance.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for IPRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill Annexure-II (absorption) or Annexure-III (deputation), attach the self-attested enclosures, and send it by post / courier or by hand to the Chief General Manager (HR), IPRCL, 4th Floor, Nirman Bhavan, Mumbai Port Trust Building, M.P. Road, Mazgaon (E), Mumbai- 400010.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IPRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on eligibility/experience (in the ratio 1:5 when there are 05 or more eligible candidates per vacancy) and called for a Personal Interview, where original documents are verified.

faq.question: Q8. Can private company employees apply for IPRCL Manager (Electrical) posts?
faq.answer: Yes, officers in a private company engaged in Railway works can apply if they meet the post's level, gross salary, managerial experience and company turnover conditions, for example at least Rs. 60 thousand per month and Rs. 100 Crs turnover for Manager (Electrical).

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for both posts in IPRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, a candidate eligible for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post.

faq.question: Q10. What is the tenure of the IPRCL deputation appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment on absorption or on deputation is for 03 years, extendable further as per rules, subject to extension of exemption from the rule of immediate absorption beyond 01.11.2028 by Ministry/DPE.
